overview: 今日专题“全球经济与金融”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

featured.title: UK car industry faces ‘difficult trade-off’ between Chinese and EU markets
featured.summary: Britain under pressure to put tariffs on cheap Chinese vehicle imports ahead of protectionist trade measures Britain’s car industry is grappling with a “difficult trade-off” between China and Europe, as manufacturers struggle to balance the benefits of both markets ahead of looming trade measures that could restrict UK exports to the EU. The UK is an outlier in choosing not to put import taxes on Chinese vehicles, even as the US has shut them out almost entirely, and the EU imposes duties of up to 45%. Continue reading...
featured.titleZh: 英国汽车工业面临中国与欧盟市场之间的“艰难权衡”
featured.summaryZh: 英国汽车制造商正处于两难境地，需在保持中国市场准入与应对欧盟潜在贸易壁垒之间寻求平衡。尽管美国和欧盟已对中国汽车征收高额关税，但英国目前尚未采取类似措施，这可能影响其对欧出口。
featured.whyImportant: 英国在贸易保护主义抬头背景下的政策选择，将直接影响其汽车产业的国际竞争力和出口稳定性。

featured.title: Young Chinese hire ‘life stand-ins’ to cook and care for elderly parents amid booming trend
featured.summary: From cooking and attending hospital visits to doing the actual quarrelling, paid “life stand-ins” are stepping in to manage these tasks, along with errands and awkward moments that many young Chinese would rather avoid. This trend, known as the “stand-in economy,” is gaining traction among time-strapped consumers who are willing to pay for convenience when daily responsibilities exceed their time, patience, or expertise. First widely reported by mainland media in 2024, the movement has since...
featured.titleZh: 中国年轻人雇佣“生活替身”来照顾年迈父母，相关趋势日益兴起
featured.summaryZh: 随着生活节奏加快，越来越多的中国年轻人开始雇佣“生活替身”来处理照顾老人、陪诊或处理琐事等任务。这种“替身经济”反映了年轻一代在面对繁重家庭责任与个人时间压力时的现实选择。
featured.whyImportant: 这一社会现象揭示了人口老龄化背景下，家庭照护需求与现代职场压力之间的矛盾正在催生新的服务业态。

featured.titleZh: 查尔默斯称全球经济动荡将推动预算削减，但澳大利亚应能避免衰退
featured.summaryZh: 澳大利亚财长吉姆·查尔默斯警告称联邦预算面临巨大压力，并指责私营部门在中东冲突背景下推高了通胀。他表示政府正在寻求削减预算的新途径，但强调目前并未计划应对经济衰退。
featured.whyImportant: 政府的财政紧缩政策与对通胀原因的归咎，反映了当前澳大利亚经济面临的复杂外部环境挑战。

featured.titleZh: 胡塞武装称袭击了沙特阿美石油设施，沙特空袭萨那
featured.summaryZh: 也门胡塞武装声称对沙特首都附近的石油设施发动了袭击，现场可见火焰和浓烟。与此同时，胡塞武装指责沙特战机对萨那进行了数十次空袭，双方冲突近期显著升级。
featured.whyImportant: 也门冲突的加剧及对能源设施的攻击可能进一步影响全球能源供应与地区稳定。

featured.summary: Small independent bookstores tucked away in walk-up tenement buildings above neon-lit streets have long made Mong Kok a sanctuary for Hong Kong book lovers, until recently when one after another was forced to close due to economic headwinds or political uncertainty. Defying the trend, 41-year-old bibliophile Grace Lau invested a six-figure sum to launch New Year Bookshop, a move driven by passion and lower rents that some in the community regarded as a bold gamble on the neighbourhood’s literary...
featured.titleZh: 香港旺角新书店开业，逆势挑战独立书店寒冬
featured.summaryZh: 尽管香港独立书店因经济和环境压力接连倒闭，但一位书迷在旺角投资开设了“新年书店”。店主希望通过较低的租金和对阅读的热情，在充满挑战的零售环境中寻找生存空间。
featured.whyImportant: 该书店的开业体现了香港文化从业者在逆境中对实体书店生存空间的坚守与尝试。

featured.titleZh: 英国真的能承受与欧盟在对华电动汽车关税上的分歧吗？
featured.summaryZh: 欧盟要求英国提高对中国汽车的关税，凸显了英国脱欧后在贸易政策上的尴尬处境。英国若想避免在欧盟“欧洲制造”规则下受到歧视，可能不得不与欧盟的对华贸易政策保持一致。

featured.summary: Christie’s auctioneer Rupert Banner leans forward with practised showmanship as bidding stalls on a rare Yongzheng bowl near New York’s iconic Rockefeller Centre. He pauses as if willing offers from thin air, scanning dozens of in-person buyers and phone banks connecting with China, London, Texas. It will be a bad look if the frenzy abates for this delicate peach-decorated bowl highlighted on Christie’s glossy Chinese sale catalogue and online advertising. But bidding soon resumes with a...
featured.titleZh: 中国艺术品从美国博物馆开启“长征”回家之路
featured.summaryZh: 在纽约佳士得的拍卖会上，中国艺术品受到全球买家的关注，许多珍贵文物正通过拍卖市场回流中国。这一现象反映了中国艺术品市场需求的增长以及全球收藏格局的变迁。
featured.whyImportant: 艺术品的回流不仅是市场行为，也反映了中国在全球文化资产配置中影响力的提升。

featured.title: Zimbabweans struggle to rebuild after fleeing xenophobia in South Africa
featured.summary: Returnees face economic hardship and limited support as they try to rebuild in Zimbabwe.
featured.titleZh: 津巴布韦人逃离南非排外暴力后艰难重建生活
featured.summaryZh: 因南非排外暴力而被迫回国的津巴布韦人，在归国后面临严重的经济困难和有限的社会支持。他们正在努力克服重重障碍，试图重建生活。
featured.whyImportant: 该问题凸显了非洲区域内移民面临的排外风险以及回国安置后的社会经济挑战。

global.title: Flydubai co-pilot attacked captain with axe, UAE official says
global.summary: Attorney general says ‘terrorist attack’ was attempted by suspect who is said to have been barred from flying by Oman because of extremist views The co-pilot of flydubai flight FZ1073 used an axe to attempt to carry out a “terrorist attack” during the Israel-bound flight, the United ⁠Arab Emirates prosecutor general has said. Disaster was narrowly averted on Wednesday when passengers and crew intervened to stop the co-pilot’s attempt to take control of the plane, which had 182 people onboard and plunged 16,625ft in just over 30 seconds. The descent was so extreme that part of the rudder was ripped off. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 阿联酋官员称迪拜航空副驾驶用斧头袭击机长
global.summaryZh: 阿联酋总检察长表示，一名迪拜航空飞往以色列航班的副驾驶试图发动“恐怖袭击”。该嫌疑人此前因极端思想被阿曼禁止飞行，此次袭击导致飞机在短时间内急剧下降，幸亏机组人员和乘客及时干预才避免了灾难。
global.whyImportant: 此事件引发了对航空安全协议及飞行员背景审查程序的严重关切。

global.titleZh: 迪拜航空副驾驶涉嫌驾驶舱袭击，澳大利亚安全机构调查其在澳期间经历
global.summaryZh: 在发生涉嫌劫机未遂事件后，澳大利亚安全机构已对该名副驾驶展开调查，因其曾以学生身份在澳居住约两年。该航班在飞往特拉维夫途中曾发生剧烈俯冲，机上182名乘客的生命安全受到严重威胁。
global.whyImportant: 调查该嫌疑人的海外背景对于评估其激进化过程及潜在的安全漏洞至关重要。

global.whyImportant: 此恶性交通事故引发了公众对道路安全及新手司机驾驶行为的广泛讨论。

global.titleZh: 巴拉圭首都遭巨大冰雹袭击，造成广泛破坏
global.summaryZh: 巴拉圭首都部分地区遭遇巨大冰雹袭击。此次极端天气导致当地窗户破碎，车辆受损严重。
global.whyImportant: 极端天气事件对城市基础设施造成的破坏凸显了气候变化带来的潜在风险。

global.title: Polish activists launch abortion pill locker to bypass near-total ban
global.summary: ‘AbortOmat’ in Warsaw offers novel way to challenge country’s restrictions and allow women swift, anonymous access They call it the “world’s first parcel locker for abortion pills”. Polish campaigners have launched a new means of distribution as part of their ongoing effort to skirt the country’s near-total ban on abortion. Painted pink and framed by zebra-striped curtains, the 22-compartment “AbortOmat” in Warsaw allows women to access the pills swiftly and anonymously using a six-digit code. The service was envisaged for those who cannot or do not want to wait days for mail delivery due to a missed miscarriage or health complications, or who worry about receiving the pills at home. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 波兰活动人士推出堕胎药储物柜以绕过近乎全面的禁令
global.summaryZh: 波兰活动人士在华沙设立了名为“AbortOmat”的储物柜，为女性提供匿名获取堕胎药的途径。该设施旨在帮助那些因健康问题或隐私顾虑而无法等待邮寄的女性，挑战该国严格的堕胎限制。
global.whyImportant: 这一举措反映了波兰民间社会在严苛法律环境下，通过创新手段保障女性生殖健康权利的持续抗争。

global.title: Mars shelter problem can be solved with engineered yeast, gelatin and sand: paper
global.summary: Future settlers on Mars would need houses, but they must either spend huge sums transporting construction materials from Earth or use enormous amounts of energy to melt Martian soil into bricks. Scientists in Hong Kong say they have developed a quick and low-cost “living” building material made from genetically engineered yeast, gelatin and sand that can be 3D printed under conditions simulating the Martian environment. global.titleZh: 论文称：工程酵母、明胶和沙子可解决火星住所问题
global.summaryZh: 香港科学家开发出一种由基因工程酵母、明胶和沙子制成的“活性”建筑材料，可在模拟火星环境下进行3D打印。这种材料成本低廉且无需从地球运输大量建筑物资，为未来火星定居提供了新方案。
global.whyImportant: 该研究为解决深空探测中建筑材料运输的高昂成本和能源消耗问题提供了潜在的科学突破。

The Sunshine Protection Act passed the House in July, but it faces roadblocks in the Senate, where some Republicans are strongly opposed to it. Proponents, including the president and his administration, argue that the change would provide more daylight during the times that Americans are most active. items.whyImportant: 极端天气事件对城市基础设施造成的破坏凸显了气候变化带来的潜在风险。

items.title: Polish activists launch abortion pill locker to bypass near-total ban
items.summary: ‘AbortOmat’ in Warsaw offers novel way to challenge country’s restrictions and allow women swift, anonymous access They call it the “world’s first parcel locker for abortion pills”. Polish campaigners have launched a new means of distribution as part of their ongoing effort to skirt the country’s near-total ban on abortion. Painted pink and framed by zebra-striped curtains, the 22-compartment “AbortOmat” in Warsaw allows women to access the pills swiftly and anonymously using a six-digit code. The service was envisaged for those who cannot or do not want to wait days for mail delivery due to a missed miscarriage or health complications, or who worry about receiving the pills at home. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 波兰活动人士推出堕胎药储物柜以绕过近乎全面的禁令
items.summaryZh: 波兰活动人士在华沙设立了名为“AbortOmat”的储物柜，为女性提供匿名获取堕胎药的途径。该设施旨在帮助那些因健康问题或隐私顾虑而无法等待邮寄的女性，挑战该国严格的堕胎限制。
items.whyImportant: 这一举措反映了波兰民间社会在严苛法律环境下，通过创新手段保障女性生殖健康权利的持续抗争。

items.title: Mars shelter problem can be solved with engineered yeast, gelatin and sand: paper
items.summary: Future settlers on Mars would need houses, but they must either spend huge sums transporting construction materials from Earth or use enormous amounts of energy to melt Martian soil into bricks. Scientists in Hong Kong say they have developed a quick and low-cost “living” building material made from genetically engineered yeast, gelatin and sand that can be 3D printed under conditions simulating the Martian environment. Their study, published online last month in Chem Circularity, an...
items.titleZh: 论文称：工程酵母、明胶和沙子可解决火星住所问题
items.summaryZh: 香港科学家开发出一种由基因工程酵母、明胶和沙子制成的“活性”建筑材料，可在模拟火星环境下进行3D打印。这种材料成本低廉且无需从地球运输大量建筑物资，为未来火星定居提供了新方案。
items.whyImportant: 该研究为解决深空探测中建筑材料运输的高昂成本和能源消耗问题提供了潜在的科学突破。

items.title: To become a dog-friendly city, Hong Kong needs dog literacy
items.summary: Since July, Hong Kong has permitted dogs in approved dining premises under a tightly regulated scheme. More than 2,200 restaurants applied, with more than 980 taking part within the first month. On the surface, these are straightforward changes to the rules around where dogs are allowed. But they reflect something more significant: a changing relationship between Hong Kong and the dogs who also call it home. Small companion breeds are familiar in urban life, while larger dogs, local mixed breeds...
items.titleZh: 要成为宠物友好型城市，香港需要提升“犬只素养”
items.summaryZh: 香港近期放宽了餐厅携带犬只的规定，已有近千家餐厅参与试点。这不仅是规则的改变，更标志着香港城市生活中人与犬只关系的演变，同时也对公众的文明养犬意识提出了更高要求。
items.whyImportant: 政策的放宽推动了城市公共空间对宠物的包容性，同时也引发了关于城市文明与宠物管理平衡的讨论。

items.title: Trump, burger, Hormuz: meet the Iranian team behind billboard war on US
items.summary: Huge billboards on the walls of Tehran mocking US President Donald Trump and depicting American drones under the boot of an Iranian soldier are providing a chronicle of Iran’s war with the United States and Israel. Khaneh-ye Tarrahan, or Designers’ House, produces the billboards with anti-US messaging for prominent locations in Tehran where they are seen daily by large crowds of passers-by, including the city’s famed Valiasr Square. The team created a towering portrayal of Trump’s lips sewn and...
items.titleZh: 特朗普、汉堡、霍尔木兹：揭秘伊朗反美广告牌背后的团队
items.summaryZh: 德黑兰街头的巨型广告牌通过讽刺美国总统特朗普和展示军事力量，传达了伊朗的反美立场。这些广告牌由名为“设计师之家”的团队制作，旨在通过视觉符号向公众传递政治信息。
items.whyImportant: 这些广告牌作为伊朗政治宣传的重要载体，直观地反映了该国当前的地缘政治立场与对美态度。

items.title: Trump shares Senator Tom Cotton’s phone number in daylight saving time clash
items.summary: US President Donald Trump shared online the supposed phone number of a Republican US senator on Saturday in an escalating dispute over making daylight saving time permanent. In a social media post, the president urged people to call a phone number he said belonged to Senator Tom Cotton, an Arkansas Republican who opposes the Trump-backed Sunshine Protection Act. The act would end the twice-yearly practice ‌of changing clocks by one hour. Trump says most Americans want more afternoon sunlight,...
items.titleZh: 特朗普在夏令时争议中公开共和党参议员汤姆·科顿的电话号码
items.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普在社交媒体上公开了共和党参议员汤姆·科顿的疑似电话号码，以施压其支持将夏令时永久化的《阳光保护法案》。特朗普此举旨在动员民众致电科顿，以打破该法案在参议院面临的阻力。
items.whyImportant: 此举凸显了美国行政与立法部门在政策推行上的激烈冲突，并引发了关于政治人物公开个人隐私作为施压手段的争议。

items.title: Trump appears to share personal phone number of US senator in ploy to push permanent daylight savings
items.summary: US president urges Americans to call Tom Cotton to support bill to make daylight saving time permanent Donald Trump on Saturday put pressure on the US senator Tom Cotton of Arkansas to support a bill to make daylight saving time permanent, urging Americans to call what appeared to be the personal cellphone number of his fellow Republican and the chair of the Senate intelligence committee. The Sunshine Protection Act passed the House in July, but it faces roadblocks in the Senate, where some Republicans are strongly opposed to it. Proponents, including the president and his administration, argue that the change would provide more daylight during the times that Americans are most active. Detractors said permanent daylight saving time would lead to darker and potentially more hazardous winter mornings when children will be waiting for school buses and parents will be driving to work in darkness. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 特朗普疑似公开美国参议员个人电话以推动永久夏令时
items.summaryZh: 特朗普总统敦促美国民众致电参议员汤姆·科顿，要求其支持将夏令时永久化的法案。尽管支持者认为此举能增加下午的日照时间，但反对者担忧这会导致冬季早晨更加黑暗，增加通勤和上学的安全风险。
items.whyImportant: 该事件反映了美国政府在推动争议性民生政策时，采取了极具对抗性的政治动员手段。

items.title: Why has Brazil accused the US of election interference?
items.summary: The Latin American country will vote for its next president, as Lula da Silva and Bolsonaro clash over sovereignty, security and ties with Washington.
items.titleZh: 巴西为何指责美国干预选举？
items.summaryZh: 在巴西总统大选临近之际，卢拉·达席尔瓦与博索纳罗在主权、安全及对美关系等议题上展开激烈交锋。巴西国内对美国在选举进程中扮演的角色提出了质疑。
items.whyImportant: 这反映了拉美国家在复杂的地缘政治环境下，对外部势力干预国内政治进程的高度敏感。

items.title: How US-China RISC-V collaboration is deepening despite chip rivalry
items.summary: As global adoption of the open-source RISC-V chip architecture accelerates, US intellectual property provider MIPS is collaborating with Chinese firms at an unprecedented level, according to a senior executive, highlighting how cross-border cooperation persists despite intense tech rivalry between Washington and Beijing. MIPS, which was acquired by US chipmaker GlobalFoundries last year, was driving RISC-V standardisation “very closely with China”, chief technology officer Yankin Tanurhan said...
items.titleZh: 尽管芯片竞争激烈，美中RISC-V合作仍在深化
items.summaryZh: 尽管美中两国在科技领域竞争加剧，但开源RISC-V芯片架构的全球采用仍在加速。美国知识产权提供商MIPS的高管表示，公司正与中国企业在RISC-V标准化方面进行深度合作。
items.whyImportant: 这表明在半导体行业，跨国技术标准合作与地缘政治竞争呈现出复杂且并行的态势。

items.title: US Coast Guard searches for missing air ambulance off coast of Massachusetts
items.summary: The plane was undertaking a medical evacuation from Bermuda with six people onboard when it lost contact The US Coast Guard said late on Saturday it had found debris from a medical transport aircraft off the shore of ⁠Massachusetts’ Nantucket Island and ⁠was searching for ​the six people who were on board. The jet lost contact with the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) during a flight from Bermuda to Boston on Saturday morning. In a statement to the Guardian, an FAA spokesperson said that the agency issued a search-and-rescue alert notice for a Gulfstream G-100 at about 1.20am local time Saturday. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 美国海岸警卫队在马萨诸塞州海岸搜寻失踪的医疗救援飞机
items.summaryZh: 一架从百慕大飞往波士顿的医疗救援飞机在飞行途中失联，机上载有6人。美国海岸警卫队已在马萨诸塞州楠塔基特岛附近海域发现飞机残骸，目前搜救工作正在进行中。
items.whyImportant: 此次空难事故引发了对医疗救援飞行安全及应急响应机制的关注。

items.title: Hong Kong’s cancer research drawing global attention, says leading body’s chief
items.summary: Hong Kong is playing a central role as part of a broader regional hub for research breakthroughs, the head of a leading global cancer organisation has said, adding that the city’s success in reducing its smoking rate has set an example for others to follow. Cary Adams, CEO of the Union for International Cancer Control, praised the city’s tobacco control efforts as the organisation held the World Cancer Congress in Hong Kong last month for the first time. “We’ve all become aware globally that the...
items.titleZh: 国际癌症组织负责人称香港癌症研究正吸引全球关注
items.summaryZh: 国际抗癌联盟首席执行官卡里·亚当斯表示，香港在癌症研究领域发挥着区域枢纽作用。他特别称赞了香港在控烟方面的成功经验，认为其为全球提供了参考范例。
items.whyImportant: 香港在公共卫生和医疗研究领域的国际认可度提升，有助于其进一步巩固作为全球医疗创新中心的地位。
